_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: jobs get
cli_commands.description: Get a durable job by id

cli_commands.name: jobs wait
cli_commands.description: Block once until a job is terminal, then print it (no polling)

cli_commands.name: jobs list
cli_commands.description: List recent jobs, newest first (--limit N)

cli_commands.name: jobs cancel
cli_commands.description: Cancel a running or queued job

cli_commands.name: jobs watch
cli_commands.description: Stream a job's progress until it reaches a terminal state

cli_commands.name: models list
cli_commands.description: List model registry entries (--operation OP to filter)

cli_commands.name: models get
cli_commands.description: Get a model registry entry by id

cli_commands.name: models select
cli_commands.description: Preview which model would run for an operation on this host (--override ID)

cli_commands.name: models enable
cli_commands.description: Enable or disable a model (persisted overlay over the seed catalog)

cli_commands.name: models blocklist
cli_commands.description: List license-encumbered models excluded from the catalog
